# Viaggio — journey snapshot import (for LLM / integrator agents)

Purpose: generate a JSON file a signed-in user can import into Viaggio to create
a new journey (people, timeline entries, expenses, playlist, place ideas, todos).

## Format

- format (required): "viaggio.journey_snapshot"
- version (required): 1
- journey (required object)
- people (required array, at least one person)
- Optional arrays: contacts, entries, entry_participants, expenses,
  expense_splits, playlist, place_ideas, todos
- exported_at (optional ISO-8601)

## Machine-readable contract

- JSON Schema: https://project-viaggio.web.app/agent/import.schema.json
- Sample JSON: https://project-viaggio.web.app/agent/sample.json
- Human spec (repo): docs/journey-snapshot.md

## How users import

1. Sign in at https://project-viaggio.web.app
2. Archives → Import JSON, or use Journey Settings export/import flows
3. Select the generated .json file

## Import rules agents must respect

- All ids in the file are opaque local strings for cross-references only;
  Viaggio remaps them to new UUIDs on import.
- journey.type: "trip" | "journal"
- journey.preset: catalog id (e.g. leisure_trip, road_trip)
- journey.default_timezone: IANA (e.g. Europe/Lisbon)
- journey.default_currency: ISO 4217 uppercase (e.g. EUR)
- entries[].activity_id must be a known catalog activity (flight, hotel, meal,
  sightseeing, ferry, train, …); unknown activities fail import.
- Signed-in importer becomes the new journey owner.

## Do not include

Auth users, passwords, invite tokens, binary attachments.
